    publish: "private" -> "request"
+ server bravo/newone
    name: "New one"
    url: "https://new.example.com/mcp"
    authMode: "static_header"
    authHeaderName: "Authorization"
    authValue: "(secret)" (read from $NEWONE_TOKEN)
    publish: "request"
~ server bravo/status
    name: "Renamed" -> "Service status"
    url: "https://other.example.com/mcp" -> "https://status.example.com/mcp"
    enabled: false -> true
